slides.headline: Demand-based tasks, common platform use and built-in safety rules for an executable plan

slots.goal: Safe, phased adoption of hyperscale AI across Gaon City's administration

strategies.title: Demand-based task selection
items: Citizen pain points from complaint data
Scores and evidence kept in task definitions

strategies.title: Common platform first
items: Same criteria for on-premise and cloud
Linkage check of city data and systems
Budget and staffing estimates per model

strategies.title: Built-in safety rules
items: AI use notice and output labeling rules
Early identification of high-impact AI tasks
Written input bans and output checks
Security checks linked to privacy safeguards
Role-based training to embed the guideline

slots.conclusion: An executable master plan that starts with services citizens feel first

slides.headline: From ad hoc departmental trials to phased adoption under city-wide rules
slides.marker: Current state and after the master plan

items.text: Each department trials AI tools on its own
sub: Tool selection criteria differ by department
Who pays for usage is still open

items.text: Security checks of AI services are case by case
sub: City criteria per service type are needed
Approval steps for new services need updating

items.text: Complaint data entry depends on each officer
sub: Rules against entering personal data are needed
Checks on AI output need to be written down

items.text: Priority tasks start from department demand
sub: Ranked by impact, urgency and feasibility
Start order set by the department council

items.text: Security checks set per adoption model
sub: Check items for platform, cloud and on-premise
Approval before a new service goes live

items.text: Input bans and output checks in force
sub: Banned input list in the AI use guideline (draft)
Role-based training to embed the guideline
